entities.name: Drake
entities.description: A creature type for flying reptiles similar to dragons but smaller and less powerful, with wings replacing one set of limbs.

entities.name: Wyvern
entities.description: Particularly large drakes with a birdlike gait, found on Jamuraa and Rath.

entities.name: Crucius
entities.description: A sphinx who perfected his designs on drakes before infusing the first humanoid with etherium.

entities.name: Ethersworn
entities.description: Those who carry out Crucius's Noble Work on Esper.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Alaran shard above which etherium-infused drakes soar.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Created the species Teferi's Drakes while studying at the Tolarian Academy.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Used Teferi's Drakes to defend the Tolarian Academy against Kerrick's forces.

entities.name: Kerrick
entities.description: Leader of forces that attacked the Tolarian Academy.

entities.name: Caliphear the Nightmare
entities.description: Killed an Azure Drake with his attendants in the Great Salt Marshes.

entities.name: Hakim Loreweaver
entities.description: Tamed an Azure Drake and used it as a pet and transport.

entities.name: Talrand
entities.description: A hydromancer allied with the drakes of the Kapsho Sea against dragons.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Imported Mirrodin's wildlife, including drakes, via soul traps.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: The school where Teferi created his drakes and Barrin defended it.

events.summary: Teferi creates Teferi's Drakes at the Tolarian Academy, and Barrin uses them to defend the university against Kerrick's forces.
events.quote: they were used by Barrin in the defense of the University against Kerrick 's forces.

events.summary: An Azure Drake is killed by Caliphear the Nightmare and his attendants.
events.quote: An Azure Drake attacked and was killed by Caliphear the Nightmare and his attendants

events.summary: Hakim Loreweaver tames an Azure Drake.
events.quote: Another Azure Drake was tamed by Hakim Loreweaver , who used it as a pet and a means of traveling.

events.summary: Crucius and the Ethersworn perfect their designs on drakes before infusing the first humanoid with etherium.
events.quote: spent years perfecting their designs on drakes before infusing the first humanoid.

events.summary: The drakes of the Kapsho Sea ally with Talrand against the dragons.
events.quote: the drakes of the Kapsho Sea have allied with the hydromancer Talrand against the dragons that used to tyrannize the sea.

relations.quote: Teferi created a species of drakes, Teferi's Drakes

relations.note: Serve him in exchange for protection.
relations.quote: In exchange for protection, they now serve Talrand.

relations.note: Imported Mirrodin's wildlife via soul traps.
relations.quote: they were imported via soul traps by Memnarch
